title: FailAllObjectives - Quest
content:
Member of: Quest Script

Flags all objectives on this quest as failed.

Syntax:
Function FailAllObjectives() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; fails all objectives on the quest
MyQuest.FailAllObjectives()

- Quest Script
- IsObjectiveFailed - Quest
- SetObjectiveFailed - Quest
